name: webapp-desktop-root
description: Monorepo: docker-compose.yml e Redis vivem aqui. Plataforma Node/TS em webapp-01; engines (Python/Node) em engines/. npm run dev na raiz delega para webapp-01. Mapa em docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

scripts.dev:stack: npm run redis:up && npm run dev --prefix webapp-01
scripts.dev:stack:watch: npm run redis:up && npm run dev:watch --prefix webapp-01
scripts.docker:watch: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile sped --profile comparacao --profile nfse --profile gnre up -d
scripts.docker:watch:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f ts-builder api worker
scripts.docker:watch:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile sped --profile comparacao --profile nfse --profile gnre down
